 Asia’s shell-chariot associates her with the sea-born Venus Aphrodite, Goddess of Love and
associated by Lucretius with the generative principle, whose emblem is a shell; the lines also anticipate
the account in II v 20–32 (see note) of Asia’s Aphrodite-like birth in a veinèd shell (cp. delicate strange
tracery).
